_comment: Copy to server/config.json and edit. Every key is optional; these are the defaults except where noted. API keys are better kept in the environment (see README) than in this file.

audio._comment: Fixed boost applied before playback; //koto volume scales on top (100 = this baseline).

duck._comment: Lower the game's audio while a line is spoken (needs pactl). See `kotodama_server.py audio list`.

tts._comment: provider: openai (the default) | elevenlabs | a model adapter such as minimax, gemini, inworld, chatterbox-turbo, kokoro (kotodama_server.py providers). //koto provider switches live. The other keys here are OpenAI's.

elevenlabs._comment: Voices are auto-cast from your account (kotodama_server.py voices sync / voices cast).

minimax._comment: MiniMax's own streaming API, used by the minimax / minimax-hd providers.

gemini._comment: Google's streaming Interactions API, used by the gemini / gemini-lite providers. Voices in these languages from Google's library, plus your own, are cast from.

inworld._comment: Inworld's OpenAI-compatible streaming endpoint, used by the inworld / inworld-flash providers. The key is the Base64 credential from platform.inworld.ai. Library voices in these languages, plus your own cloned and designed voices, are cast from.

replicate._comment: Shared by every Replicate model (minimax-replicate, chatterbox, kokoro, qwen3...). Lines are split by sentence because Replicate returns whole files.

models._comment: Add model adapters or override fields of the presets in server/tts_models.json, by name. `kotodama_server.py replicate schema owner/name` drafts one. Example: give MiniMax per-NPC emotions, and enable a self-hosted Kokoro server.

voice_bank._comment: Reference clips for cloning models (chatterbox, chatterbox-turbo, qwen3). `voices design` fills it; `voices bank` lists it.

inference._comment: Optional voice casting for NPCs nobody has described yet. provider: none | anthropic | openai
inference._model_comment: claude-haiku-5-5 is the default: cheap and fast, and plenty for casting a voice. Use claude-opus-5-5 for more considered casting.
inference._wait_comment: How long an NPC's first line waits for their casting before using a stand-in voice. unknown_wait_ms is for NPCs the game gives no race for, whose stand-in has no gender.
